author: gpt-5.6-luna
kind: a product backlog (CSV, 60 to 90 features with estimates, value notes and dependencies), customer interview notes (5 to 8 short files), a sales commitments doc and a team capacity sheet
scenario: A head of product asks the PM: we have eight weeks to the conference launch. Decide what is in, what is out, and why, so engineering can start Monday.
seeds: (1) a must-have hidden in a sales commitment that is not marked priority in the backlog; (2) a high-value feature that needs a low-value one first (dependency closure); (3) total estimate of the obvious picks exceeds capacity; (4) two interview notes ask for opposite things and only one maps to the target segment named in the launch brief; (5) a decoy: a feature with loud internal demand and no customer evidence.
